resources.string: Each person chosen receives the group\'s key in one transaction from you. Then every message is a single transaction, whatever the group\'s size. Members see the group in this app only, not on idena.social.
Saving hands a new key to the people kept and added. People removed do not get it: they cannot read what is sent with it, and their own messages stop counting. People added read from now on.
Only you see this name, on this phone. Leave it empty to take the group\'s own name back.
Only you see this name, on this phone and in this group. Leave it empty to take their own name back.

Only the group\'s members can read its messages. Who writes and when is public, on the chain for good. The group\'s name and members are not; how many they are shows each time its creator hands out a key.
